desc: Ideation: model as letter-to-letter mapping f; answer = #changed letters + #cycles; impossible if conflicting constraints or (cycle exists and all 26 letters appear in S)
Implement full solution in Python with O(N + 26) complexity, reading stdin and writing the answer to stdout.

Verify the implementation against all four samples and key edge cases (2-cycle swap with buffer, all-26-letters-in-S with cycle → -1, chain ordering, self-loop constraints), and confirm the cycle-detection code is correct.
